padded: Quilted layers of cloth and batting worn as a full suit.
leather: A breastplate and shoulder guards of stiffened, boiled leather over softer, flexible leather.
studdedLeather: Tough but flexible leather reinforced with close-set rivets or spikes.
hide: Crude armor made of thick furs and pelts.
chainShirt: A shirt of interlocking metal rings worn between layers of clothing or leather.
scaleMail: A coat and leggings of leather covered with overlapping pieces of metal, like the scales of a fish.
breastplate: A fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather, leaving the limbs free.
halfPlate: Shaped metal plates that cover most of the body, without leg protection beyond simple greaves.
ringMail: Leather armor with heavy rings sewn into it to reinforce it against blows.
chainMail: A full suit of interlocking metal rings worn over a layer of quilted fabric.
splint: Narrow vertical strips of metal riveted to a leather backing, with chain mail protecting the joints.
plate: Interlocking metal plates that cover the whole body, with a visored helmet, gauntlets and thick padding underneath.
shield: A broad piece of wood or metal carried in one hand. You gain its Armor Class benefit only if you have training with it, and you can wield only one Shield at a time.
club: A short, stout length of wood swung in one hand.
dagger: A short double-edged blade, easy to conceal and balanced for throwing.
greatclub: A heavy wooden cudgel that needs both hands.
handaxe: A small one-handed axe that can also be thrown.
javelin: A light spear made for throwing.
lightHammer: A small one-handed hammer that can also be thrown.
mace: A short haft topped with a heavy flanged or knobbed metal head.
quarterstaff: A sturdy wooden pole about as tall as its wielder.
sickle: A curved farming blade on a short handle.
spear: A wooden shaft with a pointed metal head, used to thrust or throw.
dart: A small weighted spike made for throwing.
lightCrossbow: A small crossbow drawn by hand that shoots bolts.
shortbow: A compact bow that is easy to handle and shoots arrows.
sling: A leather strap used to hurl sling bullets.
battleaxe: A broad-bladed war axe wielded in one or two hands.
flail: A spiked metal head attached to a handle by a chain.
glaive: A long pole ending in a single-edged blade.
greataxe: A massive axe swung with both hands.
greatsword: A long, heavy sword that needs both hands.
halberd: A pole weapon that combines an axe blade with a spike.
lance: A long cavalry spear. It needs two hands unless you are mounted.
longsword: A straight double-edged sword wielded in one or two hands.
maul: A huge two-handed hammer with a heavy head.
morningstar: A haft topped with a spiked metal ball.
pike: A very long infantry spear held in both hands.
rapier: A slender thrusting sword with a protective hilt.
scimitar: A light sword with a curved blade.
shortsword: A short, straight blade made for quick thrusts.
warhammer: A hammer built for battle, wielded in one or two hands.
warPick: A pointed metal pick on a haft, made to punch through armor.
blowgun: A long tube through which needles are blown. A hit deals 1 Piercing damage.
handCrossbow: A small crossbow that can be shot with one hand.
heavyCrossbow: A large, powerful crossbow that is slow to reload.
longbow: A tall bow with a long range that shoots arrows.
musket: A long-barrelled firearm loaded with one bullet at a time.
pistol: A one-handed firearm loaded with one bullet at a time.
acid: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a vial of Acid. Target one creature or object you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take 2d6 Acid damage.
alchemistsFire: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a flask of Alchemist's Fire. Target one creature or object you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take 1d4 Fire damage and start burning.
arrows: Ammunition for weapons with the Ammunition property. Each attack expends one piece; after a fight you can spend 1 minute to recover half of what you used. Sold in lots of 20; usually stored in a Quiver.
bolts: Ammunition for weapons with the Ammunition property. Each attack expends one piece; after a fight you can spend 1 minute to recover half of what you used. Sold in lots of 20; usually stored in a Crossbow Bolt Case.
firearmBullets: Ammunition for weapons with the Ammunition property. Each attack expends one piece; after a fight you can spend 1 minute to recover half of what you used. Sold in lots of 10; usually stored in a Pouch.
slingBullets: Ammunition for weapons with the Ammunition property. Each attack expends one piece; after a fight you can spend 1 minute to recover half of what you used. Sold in lots of 20; usually stored in a Pouch.
needles: Ammunition for weapons with the Ammunition property. Each attack expends one piece; after a fight you can spend 1 minute to recover half of what you used. Sold in lots of 50; usually stored in a Pouch.
antitoxin: As a Bonus Action, you can drink a vial of Antitoxin to gain Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.
arcaneFocusCrystal: An Arcane Focus is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use it as a Spellcasting Focus.
arcaneFocusOrb: An Arcane Focus is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use it as a Spellcasting Focus.
arcaneFocusRod: An Arcane Focus is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use it as a Spellcasting Focus.
arcaneFocusStaff: An Arcane Focus is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. This staff is also a Quarterstaff.
arcaneFocusWand: An Arcane Focus is bejeweled or carved to channel arcane magic. A Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard can use it as a Spellcasting Focus.
backpack: A Backpack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot. It can also serve as a saddlebag.
ballBearings: As a Utilize action, you can spill Ball Bearings from their pouch. They spread to cover a level, 10-foot-square area within 10 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Ball Bearings.
barrel: A Barrel holds up to 40 gallons of liquid or up to 4 cubic feet of dry goods.
basket: A Basket holds up to 40 pounds within 2 cubic feet.
bedroll: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold.
bell: When rung as a Utilize action, a Bell produces a sound that can be heard up to 60 feet away.
blanket: While wrapped in a blanket, you have Advantage on saving throws against extreme cold.
blockAndTackle: A Block and Tackle allows you to hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.
book: A Book contains fiction or nonfiction. If you consult an accurate nonfiction Book about its topic, you gain a +5 bonus to Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion) checks you make about that topic.
glassBottle: A Glass Bottle holds up to 1½ pints.
bucket: A Bucket holds up to half a cubic foot of contents.
burglarsPack: A Burglar's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Ball Bearings, Bell, 10 Candles, Crowbar, Hooded Lantern, 7 flasks of Oil, 5 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, and Waterskin.
caltrops: As a Utilize action, you can spread Caltrops from their bag to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Caltrops.
candle: For 1 hour, a lit Candle sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 5 feet.
crossbowBoltCase: A Crossbow Bolt Case holds up to 20 Bolts.
mapOrScrollCase: A Map or Scroll Case holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.
chain: As a Utilize action, you can wrap a Chain around an unwilling creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition if you succeed on a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. If the creature's legs are bound, it has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping requires a successful DC 18 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action. Bursting the Chain requires a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check as an action.
chest: A Chest holds up to 12 cubic feet of contents.
climbersKit: A Climber's Kit includes boot tips, gloves, pitons, and a harness. As a Utilize action, you can use the Climber's Kit to anchor yourself; when you do, you can't fall more than 25 feet from the anchor point, and you can't move more than 25 feet from there without undoing the anchor as a Bonus Action.
fineClothes: Fine Clothes are made of expensive fabrics and adorned with expertly crafted details. Some events and locations admit only people wearing these clothes.
travelersClothes: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.
componentPouch: A Component Pouch is watertight and filled with compartments that hold all the free Material components of your spells.
costume: While wearing a Costume, you have Advantage on any ability check you make to impersonate the person or type of person it represents.
crowbar: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.
diplomatsPack: A Diplomat's Pack contains the following items: Chest, Fine Clothes, Ink, 5 Ink Pens, Lamp, 2 Map or Scroll Cases, 4 flasks of Oil, 5 sheets of Paper, 5 sheets of Parchment, Perfume, and Tinderbox.
druidicFocusSprigOfMistletoe: A Druidic Focus is carved, tied with ribbon, or painted to channel primal magic. A Druid or Ranger can use it as a Spellcasting Focus.
druidicFocusWoodenStaff: A Druidic Focus is carved, tied with ribbon, or painted to channel primal magic. A Druid or Ranger can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. This staff is also a Quarterstaff.
druidicFocusYewWand: A Druidic Focus is carved, tied with ribbon, or painted to channel primal magic. A Druid or Ranger can use it as a Spellcasting Focus.
dungeoneersPack: A Dungeoneer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Caltrops, Crowbar, 2 flasks of Oil, 10 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, 10 Torches, and Waterskin.
entertainersPack: An Entertainer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Bedroll, Bell, Bullseye Lantern, 3 Costumes, Mirror, 8 flasks of Oil, 9 days of Rations, Tinderbox, and Waterskin.
explorersPack: An Explorer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Bedroll, 2 flasks of Oil, 10 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, 10 Torches, and Waterskin.
flask: A Flask holds up to 1 pint.
grapplingHook: As a Utilize action, you can throw the Grappling Hook at a railing, a ledge, or another catch within 50 feet of yourself, and the hook catches on if you succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If you tied a Rope to the hook, you can then climb it.
healersKit: A Healer's Kit has ten uses. As a Utilize action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an Unconscious creature that has 0 Hit Points without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.
holySymbolAmulet: A Holy Symbol is bejeweled or painted to channel divine magic. A Cleric or Paladin can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. An Amulet must be worn or held.
holySymbolEmblem: A Holy Symbol is bejeweled or painted to channel divine magic. A Cleric or Paladin can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. An Emblem is borne on fabric (such as a tabard or banner) or a Shield.
holySymbolReliquary: A Holy Symbol is bejeweled or painted to channel divine magic. A Cleric or Paladin can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. A Reliquary must be held.
holyWater: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a flask of Holy Water. Target one creature you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take 2d8 Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead.
huntingTrap: As a Utilize action, you can set a Hunting Trap, a sawtooth steel ring chained to an immobile object that snaps shut when a creature steps on its pressure plate. That creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. Until it breaks free, its movement is limited by the chain (typically 3 feet). A creature can use its action to make a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check to free itself or another creature; each failed check deals 1 Piercing damage to the trapped creature.
ink: Ink comes in a 1-ounce bottle, which provides enough ink to write about 500 pages.
inkPen: Using Ink, an Ink Pen is used to write or draw.
jug: A Jug holds up to 1 gallon.
ladder: A Ladder is 10 feet tall. You must climb to move up or down it.
lamp: A Lamp burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.
bullseyeLantern: A Bullseye Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 60-foot Cone and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.
lantern: A Hooded Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. As a Bonus Action, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to Dim Light in a 5-foot radius, or raise it again.
lock: A Lock comes with a key. Without the key, a creature can use Thieves' Tools to pick this Lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.
magnifyingGlass: A Magnifying Glass grants Advantage on any ability check made to appraise or inspect a highly detailed item. Lighting a fire with a Magnifying Glass requires light as bright as sunlight to focus, tinder to ignite, and about 5 minutes for the fire to ignite.
manacles: As a Utilize action, you can use Manacles to bind an unwilling Small or Medium creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition if you succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. While bound, a creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls, and it is Restrained if the Manacles are attached to a fixed chain or hook. Escaping requires a DC 20 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check as an action; bursting them requires a DC 25 Strength (Athletics) check. Manacles come with a key; the lock can be picked with Thieves' Tools (DC 15).
map: If you consult an accurate Map, you gain a +5 bonus to Wisdom (Survival) checks you make to find your way in the place represented on it.
mirror: A handheld steel Mirror is useful for personal cosmetics but also for peeking around corners and reflecting light as a signal.
net: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a Net. Target a creature you can see within 15 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or have the Restrained condition until it escapes; a Huge or larger target succeeds automatically. To escape, the target or a creature within 5 feet of it must take an action to make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check. Destroying the Net (AC 10; 5 HP; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage) also frees the target.
oil: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask at a creature or object within 20 feet; it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil, taking an extra 5 Fire damage if it takes Fire damage within 1 minute. As a Utilize action, you can pour it over a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet; if lit, it burns for 2 rounds and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. As fuel, a flask burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern.
paper: One sheet of Paper can hold about 250 handwritten words.
parchment: One sheet of Parchment can hold about 250 handwritten words.
perfume: Perfume comes in a 4-ounce vial. For 1 hour after applying Perfume to yourself, you have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to influence an Indifferent Humanoid within 5 feet of yourself.
basicPoison: As a Bonus Action, you can use a vial of Basic Poison to coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition. A creature that takes Piercing or Slashing damage from the poisoned weapon or ammunition takes an extra 1d4 Poison damage. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever comes first.
pole: A Pole is 10 feet long. You can use it to touch something up to 10 feet away. If you must make a Strength (Athletics) check as part of a High or Long Jump, you can use the Pole to vault, giving yourself Advantage on the check.
ironPot: An Iron Pot holds up to 1 gallon.
potionOfHealing: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.
pouch: A Pouch holds up to 6 pounds within one-fifth of a cubic foot.
priestsPack: A Priest's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Blanket, Holy Water, Lamp, 7 days of Rations, Robe, and Tinderbox.
quiver: A Quiver holds up to 20 Arrows.
portableRam: You can use a Portable Ram to break down doors. When doing so, you gain a +4 bonus to the Strength check. One other character can help you use the ram, giving you Advantage on this check.
rations: Rations consist of travel-ready food, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts. See "Malnutrition" for the risks of not eating.
robe: A Robe has vocational or ceremonial significance. Some events and locations admit only people wearing a Robe bearing certain colors or symbols.
rope: As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. If the creature's legs are bound, it has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.
sack: A Sack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot.
scholarsPack: A Scholar's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Book, Ink, Ink Pen, Lamp, 10 flasks of Oil, 10 sheets of Parchment, and Tinderbox.
shovel: Working for 1 hour, you can use a Shovel to dig a hole that is 5 feet on each side in soil or similar material.
signalWhistle: When blown as a Utilize action, a Signal Whistle produces a sound that can be heard up to 600 feet away.
spellScrollCantrip: A Spell Scroll (Cantrip) is a magic item that bears the words of a cantrip determined by the scroll's creator. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll and cast the spell using its normal casting time and without providing any Material components. If the spell requires a saving throw or an attack roll, the spell save DC is 13, and the attack bonus is +5. The scroll disintegrates when the casting is completed.
spellScrollLevel1: A Spell Scroll (Level 1) is a magic item that bears the words of a level 1 spell determined by the scroll's creator. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll and cast the spell using its normal casting time and without providing any Material components. If the spell requires a saving throw or an attack roll, the spell save DC is 13, and the attack bonus is +5. The scroll disintegrates when the casting is completed.
ironSpikes: Iron Spikes come in bundles of ten. As a Utilize action, you can use a blunt object, such as a Light Hammer, to hammer a spike into wood, earth, or a similar material. You can do so to jam a door shut or to then tie a Rope or Chain to the Spike.
spyglass: Objects viewed through a Spyglass are magnified to twice their size.
string: String is 10 feet long. You can tie a knot in it as a Utilize action.
tent: A Tent sleeps up to two Small or Medium creatures.
tinderbox: A Tinderbox is a small container holding flint, fire steel, and tinder (usually dry cloth soaked in light oil) used to kindle a fire. Using it to light a Candle, Lamp, Lantern, or Torch—or anything else with exposed fuel—takes a Bonus Action. Lighting any other fire takes 1 minute.
torch: A Torch burns for 1 hour, casting Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. When you take the Attack action, you can attack with the Torch, using it as a Simple Melee weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1 Fire damage.
vial: A Vial holds up to 4 ounces.
waterskin: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk dehydration.
ridingSaddle: A saddle comes with a bit, a bridle, reins, and any other equipment needed to use it.
militarySaddle: A saddle comes with a bit, a bridle, reins, and any other equipment needed to use it. A Military Saddle gives Advantage on any ability check you make to remain mounted.
exoticSaddle: A saddle comes with a bit, a bridle, reins, and any other equipment needed to use it. An Exotic Saddle is required for riding an aquatic or a flying mount.
feed: One day of fodder for a mount or pack animal.
alchemistsSupplies: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Identify a substance (DC 15), or start a fire (DC 15).
brewersSupplies: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Detect poisoned drink (DC 15), or identify alcohol (DC 10).
calligraphersSupplies: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Write text with impressive flourishes that guard against forgery (DC 15).
carpentersTools: Ability: Strength. Utilize: Seal or pry open a door or container (DC 20).
cartographersTools: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Draft a map of a small area (DC 15).
cobblersTools: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Modify footwear to give Advantage on the wearer's next Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (DC 10).
cooksUtensils: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Improve food's flavor (DC 10), or detect spoiled or poisoned food (DC 15).
glassblowersTools: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Discern what a glass object held in the past 24 hours (DC 15).
jewelersTools: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Discern a gem's value (DC 15).
leatherworkersTools: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Add a design to a leather item (DC 10).
masonsTools: Ability: Strength. Utilize: Chisel a symbol or hole in stone (DC 10).
paintersSupplies: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Paint a recognizable image of something you've seen (DC 10).
pottersTools: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Discern what a ceramic object held in the past 24 hours (DC 15).
smithsTools: Ability: Strength. Utilize: Pry open a door or container (DC 20).
tinkersTools: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Assemble a Tiny item composed of scrap, which falls apart in 1 minute (DC 20).
weaversTools: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Mend a tear in clothing (DC 10), or sew a Tiny design (DC 10).
woodcarversTools: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Carve a pattern in wood (DC 10).
forgeryKit: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Mimic 10 or fewer words of someone else's handwriting (DC 15), or duplicate a wax seal (DC 20).
gamingSetDice: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Discern whether someone is cheating (DC 10), or win the game (DC 20).
gamingSetDragonchess: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Discern whether someone is cheating (DC 10), or win the game (DC 20).
gamingSetPlayingCards: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Discern whether someone is cheating (DC 10), or win the game (DC 20).
gamingSetThreeDragonAnte: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Discern whether someone is cheating (DC 10), or win the game (DC 20).
herbalismKit: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Identify a plant (DC 10).
bagpipes: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15).
drum: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15).
dulcimer: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15).
flute: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15).
horn: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15).
lute: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15).
lyre: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15).
panFlute: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15).
shawm: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15).
viol: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15).
navigatorsTools: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Plot a course (DC 10), or determine position by stargazing (DC 15).
poisonersKit: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Detect a poisoned object (DC 10).
thievesTools: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Pick a lock (DC 15), or disarm a trap (DC 15).
ale: A mug of ale, about one pint.
bread: A loaf of bread: half a day of food.
cheese: A wedge of cheese: half a day of food.
wineCommon: A bottle of ordinary table wine, about a pint and a half.
wineFine: A bottle of fine vintage wine, about a pint and a half.
mealSqualid: Scraps and thin gruel, barely enough to keep going.
mealPoor: Coarse bread, boiled vegetables and little else.
mealModest: A plain, filling plate of stew and bread.
mealComfortable: A good meal with meat, fresh bread and something to drink.
mealWealthy: Several well-cooked courses served with care.
mealAristocratic: A banquet of rare dishes fit for a noble table.
reinforcedBackpack: A backpack with a stitched frame and wide straps. It holds up to 40 pounds, and what it carries counts 10% lighter toward your load.
expeditionPack: A framed pack with a hip belt, built for long journeys. It holds up to 60 pounds, and what it carries counts 20% lighter toward your load.
masterExplorersPack: A masterwork pack that spreads its weight across the whole body. It holds up to 90 pounds, and what it carries counts 30% lighter toward your load.
